title: config/generated.json
description: The deliberate exceptions to the generated-file rule of AGENTS.md, read by the pre-commit hook (generated-files.mts): a staged path with a generated segment is accepted only when one of these globs matches it.

exceptions.description: Globs of repository paths, read by picomatch with dot: true, that a generated segment may stay in, such as test fixtures. A glob names one deliberate file set, never a whole generated folder.
